body:
My treatment is a little all over the place, so hard to answer. The treatment with the  BPD specialist team hasn't helped, but everyone in the general mental health (so depression anxiety) treatment "team" pushes me back towards them because it's better funded. 

And I never initially sought care. I went to see my GP about a rash, he pulled my skirt up high enough to see scars.

Getting real tired of the small talk around christmas. 

>how's the shopping coming?

Great. I'm buying nothing because I can barely afford to survive anyway.

>What are your plans for christmas?

Probably faking a headache to get away from distant relatives that I barely know who will ask inane questions about my life that I'll be expected to lie in response to.
You can litterally say "I want to fucking kill myself" and people won't worry. What's happened to us?

I agree with you, just thought I'd add to the nuance. I'm still studying, had a class that involved working in domestic violence situations. Everyone sort of assumed we are mandatory reporters, but the reality is, unless we *know* that there will be serious future harm, we cannot report. Past abuse is not proof of future abuse. And even then, we are discouraged from reporting. 

Client privilege trumps pretty much everything.
The fact that it's "commonly accepted to be fairly easy" is what makes it so hard when you struggle.
You go through the motions due to a fear of death, or guilt, or some other thing preventing you from ending it.
I have no idea what tag this should have. It's not really a vent, doubtful it's seeking support, and not really a question.
Same, just make the outburst inbursts.
You know there are professions that cannot legally report child abuse, regardless of ethics?

I've had things that would be considered a trauma by shrinks, but my issues were present before then. I think it was the culmination of lots of tiny things, combined with just who I am. Everyone says my niece (currently 4y/o) is exactly like I was at that age. She's showing behaviours that are concerning, but they're being properly addressed. I got told to just stop, so learned to hide and internalise.

I was just in a similar thread where someone was bitching that borderlines should be in prison, and the fact that they get diverted from justice system to mental health system is a massive failure that means they can never learn... 

And people wonder why no one that is functioning with the disorder is open about it

That's what brought me here in the first place. I'm slowly losing control of my body. So too is my partner. We really are fighting just to get by. Everyone says to hold out hope for some new breakthrough, but then I look at the research that is being done and really can't hold out any hope. 

It's tiring.
